description: This file contains a class DevelopmentClusterMembershipOptionsValidator which implements IConfigurationValidator. Its purpose is to validate the configuration options related to development cluster membership in Orleans, specifically checking if the primary silo endpoint is set when using a system target based membership table.

classes.name: DevelopmentClusterMembershipOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validator class for DevelopmentClusterMembershipOptions, ensuring proper configuration for development clustering.

methods.name: DevelopmentClusterMembershipOptionsValidator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes options and membershipTable fields using dependency injection.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Validates the configuration, throws an exception if primary silo endpoint is null when using a system target based membership table.
